policy.integerRounding: crop bottom floor in full-product coordinates
policy.boundaryDerivation: minimum reviewed safe boundary (popcorn delivery): (overlay y483 - aligned full-product top y449 - 2px) / full-product height73 = 32/73
policy.topRule: first row reaching 55% of maximum opaque row occupancy within retained band; capped at one-third band height
policy.sideRule: tight horizontal opaque bounds of the retained upper band; both sides retained, never left-only
policy.maskRule: preserve source alpha; consumers mask transparency independently
policy.scope: shared conservative geometry only; unobserved products and contexts are not screen validated
